sildenafil.t: Do not use isosorbide mononitrate in patients who are taking certain drugs for erectile dysfunction (phosphodiesterase inhibitors), such as sildenafil, tadalafil, or vardenafil.
WARNINGS Amplification of the vasodilatory effects of isosorbide mononitrate by sildenafil can result in severe hypotension.

ccb.t: Marked symptomatic orthostatic hypotension has been reported when calcium channel blockers and organic nitrates were used in combination.
